description: Any IRS-recognized US exempt organization by EIN or name (+ optional state): name, city/state, 501(c) subsection, NTEE code, ruling date, deductibility, foundation type, IRS BMF asset/income/revenue amounts and Form 990 / 990-EZ / 990-PF financials per tax period (revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, net assets, contributions, program revenue, officer compensation, salaries, employees, grants paid). From IRS public data files. $0.005

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

limit.description: Max orgs for name search (default 10, max 50)
